about.title: We make <accent>stories</accent> the way others fold paper.
about.lead: Lunireve is a digital publishing house, based between Paris and Toulon. We write, illustrate and record stories for children ages 3 to 11 — with the patience you'd give to a book you actually print.
about.storyP1: It began one December evening. Our six-year-old daughter asked for a story where she would be the hero, "for real". We opened a notebook, and in two voices, we made up an adventure on a night train. She fell asleep before the end. The next day, she asked for another.
about.storyP2: We looked around: apps, podcasts, personalised books. Nothing brought together the quality of a real publishing house, the warmth of a voice reading aloud, and the tenderness of a story written for one specific child. So we decided to build it.
about.storyP3: Lunireve means French authors, illustrators who draw by hand before the machine, actors recording in Paris studios — and yes, a little artificial intelligence, always reviewed by a human. Nothing is published without being read aloud to a child first.
about.valueLiteraryDesc: Published authors, a French editorial sensibility, a language you enjoy hearing.
about.valueFamilyDesc: Our stories last exactly the time of a shared moment — never too short, never endless.
about.valueCraftedDesc: Every story passes through an author, a teacher and a voice actor before it reaches you.
about.valueBilingualDesc: French and English, written separately — not machine-translated. Because two languages grow together.
about.trustSubtitle: A parent's trust isn't a given. We earn it every day, through visible choices.
about.trustGdprDesc: Your data and your children's stays in Europe, encrypted, never sold. Deleted on request.
about.trustAiDesc: We use AI as a writing assistant, never as an author. Every story is reviewed and signed by a human.
about.trustPediatricDesc: Speech therapists, paediatricians and teachers review our stories — age-appropriate pacing and vocabulary.
about.ctaTitle: Open a book, close a screen.
about.ctaBody: Create a free account and listen to your first story tonight. No credit card, no commitment.
